original_value: 3D cadastral systems are more complex than traditional cadastral systems and they require more complex technical solutions and innovative use of developing technologies. Regarding data integrity and data consistency, 3D cadastral data should be maintained by a Database Management System (DBMS). Furthermore, there are still challenges regarding visualization of 3D cadastral data. A prototype of the 3D cadastral system based on a NoSQL database and a JavaScript application for 3D visualization is designed and tested in order to investigate the possibilities of using new technical solutions. It is assumed that this approach, with further development, could be a good basis for the development of a modern 3D cadastral system. MongoDB database is used for storing data and Cesium JavaScript library is used for 3D visualization. The system uses an LADM (Land Administration Domain Model) based data model. Additionally, script languages, libraries, application programming interfaces (APIs), software and data formats are used for the system development. The case study is based on the real cadastral data. The underground object and building units located below and above the ground level are used to test the proposed data model and the system’s functionality. The proposed system needs further development in order to provide full support to a modern 3D cadastral system. However, it allows maintenance of 3D cadastral data and basic 3D visualization with the interactive approach.

result.paraphrase: 3D cadastral systems are more complex than traditional cadastral systems and require more advanced technical solutions as well as innovative use of emerging technologies. To preserve data integrity and consistency, 3D cadastral data should be managed by a Database Management System (DBMS). Visualization of 3D cadastral data remains challenging. To explore the potential of new technical solutions, a prototype 3D cadastral system using a NoSQL database and a JavaScript application for 3D visualization was designed and tested. It is assumed that, with further development, this approach could provide a solid foundation for a modern 3D cadastral system. MongoDB is used to store the data, and the Cesium JavaScript library is used for 3D visualization. The system is built on an LADM (Land Administration Domain Model) based data model. In addition, script languages, libraries, application programming interfaces (APIs), software, and data formats are used in the system development. The case study is based on real cadastral data. Underground objects and building units located below and above ground level are used to test the proposed data model and the system’s functionality. The proposed system still requires further development to fully support a modern 3D cadastral system. However, it enables maintenance of 3D cadastral data and basic interactive 3D visualization.
